protocol.data: 22 T-LESS development objects of decoupled_development_20261020_r4 only; 1466 conditions x 6 candidates
protocol.outer_folds: the 5 object folds stored in group_oof/outer_oof_predictions.csv (outer_fold column)
protocol.nested: inside each outer training set: base models refit; 3 GroupKFold object folds give the out-of-object base predictions and classifier scores used to fit the residual model; 3 further object cross-fits give the nonnegative offset b; held-out objects are never used for fitting

base_model.preprocessing: median imputation with indicators, standardisation, clip to [-20, 20]
base_model.weights: each object total weight 1, split equally over its physical instances, then rows

protocol.utility: u = mean(dAR_VSD, dAR_MSSD, dAR_MSPD) - 0.005 * dADD-S / 5 mm

residual.target: adverse utility residual r = u_hat - u (out-of-object)
residual.inputs: state features + 4 predicted changes + 5 classifier scores
residual.width: w = max(0, q_hat(z) + b); score L = u_hat - w

A.role: ranking by base predicted utility, no correction

A_obs.role: same, base model also given the observability state

D_obs.role: correction given the observability state, base without it

SARef_obs.role: candidate method: base and correction both given the state

protocol.selection: per condition: argmax score over candidates with features_valid, pose_changed and observation_support >= 0.01; conditions ranked globally by that score; the top c accepted
protocol.metric: object-equal mean dAR (pp, mean of VSD/MSSD/MSPD AR changes, 0 if not accepted) averaged over coverage c = 0.05, 0.10, ..., 1.00 (gain AUC)
protocol.decision: PASS iff the 95% lower bound of BOTH differences in gain AUC is > 0; otherwise FAIL and stop
protocol.after_pass: freeze SARef_obs; confirm on a dataset never used before, under a protocol fixed before running
protocol.after_fail: no held-out evaluation; the contribution statement must be revised to what the data support
reported_not_decisive: D - A (reproduction of the known result)
max gain, AR-drop and ADD-S-increase rates at matched coverage, gain at matched AR-drop rate
omitted_for_all_arms: risk / ADD-S upper / component / branch gates
probability calibration and the 0.064 bias guard
